name: Bellefair
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for Bellefair, a Latin typeface by Nick Shinn with a Hebrew companion by Liron Lavi Turkenich.
description: Specimen page for the Bellefair typeface in the Google Fonts library. The page body renders with JavaScript and was not readable; its title and meta description credit the Latin design to Nick Shinn and a Hebrew typeface added to the project by Liron Lavi Turkenich.
